correctness.rationale: For odd n, support directions decompose into n vertex cones and n arc cones each length 2alpha=pi/n, giving equal-weight distribution of R cos T and w-R cos T, T uniform[0,alpha]. For m independent Haar rotations, hull support maximum has CDF F^m; Cauchy support formula and integration yield exact perimeter formula and strict monotonicity, Barbier case m=1. Taylor/Watson endpoint integral gives 8pi R alpha²/m² deficit; upper CDF tail gives fixed-direction 2R alpha² E² weak limit. Phase rotations modulo q=2pi/n yield largest cyclic gap G_m, and on G_m<q/2 support is R cos(nearest vertex angular distance), yielding exact Delta_m=R(1-cos(G_m/2)); exceptional event probability <=m 2^(-(m-1)). Dirichlet exponential spacing representation implies mG_m/q-log m => Gumbel and logarithm-square Hausdorff scale. Fixed-m large-n beta integral gives coefficient A_m=(4-2^(1-m))/((m+1)(m+2)). Independent SciPy quadrature confirmed m=1 exactly pi w and m=2 closed formula for n=3,5,9 and m=5,30 trends; asymptotic proof is analytic.
